what: 3-D symmetry-consistency retro-check of published stage_b4 dopant maps (geo-prewarp contribution to SYMMETRY_GATE_REPORT.md)
method: vol-weighted variance fraction of the group-symmetric component of s_map; group elements matched node->mirrored-node by KDTree; frac = ||P s - mean||^2 / ||s - mean||^2. PASS iff >= 0.8.
field_symmetry_basis: forward.py: electrodes at y=+/-L/2 (l.275/277) => EQS |E|^2 symmetric in x,y,z; convection ONE-SIDED on top face y=+L/2 (l.111,564) => thermal+objective NOT y-mirror symmetric. CORRECT group for a centered part = {x,z mirrors} (+ build-axis rotation for a body of revolution); y EXCLUDED.
group_correction_is_load_bearing: square scores 0.860 under the correct x,z group but 0.699 under the full x,y,z group. A gate that includes y-mirror would FALSE-REJECT the square at a 0.8 threshold, because its top/bottom asymmetry is PHYSICAL (one-sided convection), not residue. This is why the group must intersect the CONVECTION-boundary symmetry, not just electrode+part+objective.

cylinder_phase_c.axis: Z (longest extent 0.0597 m ~ full chamber; NOT Y - the campaign lane assumed Y)
cylinder_phase_c.required_group: {x,z mirrors} (Klein-4): part is axisymmetric about Z but the FIELD (electrodes y=+/-L/2) is only mirror-symmetric, so part INTERSECT field = mirrors; y excluded by one-sided top convection

conclusion: cube + square are spatially SOUND under the required group. pyramid (0.354) is mostly numerical residue, the SAME defect class as the Phase C cylinder (0.25) - budget-limited stop (converged=False, AL damped-oscillated on the sharp apex) fitting coarse-mesh discretization-frame error. Pyramid must be re-solved (symmetric-subspace or higher budget) before it can be cited/shipped.
